name: City's Light
source:
The city of Beacon Perch is always dark. A single light burns brightly, illuminating it and giving it life and vitality, the heart and soul of the city.

You're going to steal it.

[From [url=https://knowit01.itch.io/citys-light]Itch.io[/url]]
